conclusion: No correctness objection found in static source review; performance acceptance still requires the root-controlled comparisons.
diagnostic_helper: Both failing address conditions remain: alignment first, lookup-capacity second. Each returns FALSE before indexing lookup.

Helper recomputes page size and, for aligned input, lookup capacity only on rejected addresses. Configuration immutability is already required by the cache geometry and has no new concurrency requirement.
Unaligned/out-of-capacity warning content remains the same. Logging moves out of line and UNLIKELY guides code generation, without changing error handling.
Internal operations on established mappings still assert if the shared fallible check rejects the address.
miss_helper: Synchronous misses validate before deciding BAD_PARAM, BUSY, or blocking disk admission. Hits still skip allocation validation.

Async validation remains at the exact original outer-coroutine location before async_await_subroutine(clockcache_get_from_disk_async). No state field, label, yield location, callback, retry or validation count changes.
The helper introduces one ordinary C call on actual misses. It neither reserves a cache entry nor performs I/O on its own, so rejection still precedes those actions.
prefetch: Both prefetch API implementations are otherwise unchanged from original.
First and last range endpoints still pass the common shape check and allocator membership check before any mapping publication; integer overflow is rejected before last-address computation.
Whole-extent hints still require extent alignment; invalid hints still return without I/O or publication.
No prefetch endpoint/member validation is replaced by the noinline load helper or omitted.
validation_plan: Same existing invalid-address/writeback suite, deterministic prefetch admission, core error propagation, release quick tests and sanitizer writeback checks as isolated-miss review. Additional tests that merely mirror outlining are unnecessary.
performed: Source review only; no build, test, benchmark or variant edit.
